United with notes of dry juniper berry, patchouli and green leaves for a fresh, green feel, this special scent then develops into notes of musk, smoky cade and woody ambrox. The result? You’re not the only one… Good thing The Nue Co.’s Mind Energy is here to help; formulated using sustainable and upcycled extracts, this vegan fragrance harnesses patented neuroscience technology to stimulate neural pathways and invigorate your focus. The formula itself is centred around the knowledge that our sense of smell has a direct line to the three most important areas of the brain: the orbitofrontal cortex, which signifies awareness; the hippocampus, which is linked to memory; and the amygdala, which is directly associated with our emotions and mood. By stimulating these areas, this fragrance supplement helps to cut through mental fog and hone your focus. In consumer trials after 30 days of use, 86% of people felt they had more focus and 76% felt their productivity levels improved.

Name: The Nue Co. Forest Lungs Mood-Balancing Fragrance 50ml
Short description: While we might like to pack our bags and live a reclusive life in the mountains, it's not all that feasible; even taking a trip feels near-impossible in the current climate. This innovative fragrance replicates the molecular compounds produced by trees (read: phytoncides) that are credited for the positive health benefits associated with forest bathing, namely the balancing of stress levels and boosting the parasympathetic (rest) nervous system. Now available in the original (50ml) and a mini (10ml) vial, you can keep a spray at home and slip one in your everyday bag.

Once you’ve finished your treatment, wipe the treatment window clean with a wet, lint-free cloth.

Description:
Why It's Cult:
Explore the innovative FOREO range at Cult Beauty and discover its award-winning cleansing devices, microcurrent massager tools and ultra-hygienic oral care. If you choose to remove your hair, do so effortlessly at home with FOREO's PEACH 2 Go in Lavender. Powered by intense pulsed light (IPL), this device uses up to 120 flashes per minute for quick, effective removal of hairs on the face and body. This compact, travel-friendly tool has five intensities and two modes to ensure no hair goes missed no matter the size. Plus, with a built-in cooling system it offers a comfortable experience. It's so easy to use; simply pair with the smart app to guide you through your routine and watch the hair slowly disappear (in over 12 weeks).

How to Use:
Download the FOREO app to unlock and register your PEACH 2 in Mint before first use. You can do this by scanning the QR code on the back of the packaging, or on the Quick Start Guide that comes with your device. Shave all hair from the area you wish to treat, then clean your skin and pat dry. Scan your skin via the FOREO app to set your device for optimal treatment and select your preferences. Apply FOREO PEACH Cooling Gel (sold separately) to your treatment area and massage into skin until fully absorbed. Then plug in your PEACH 2 in Mint and adjust to your preferred intensity level using the plus and minus buttons. Start your treatment by placing the full treatment window of the device on your skin. For larger treatment areas use the gliding mode, by holding the flash button and gliding along skin. For smaller areas, use stamp mode, by pressing and releasing the flash button. For sensitive areas, you can use the lower intensity levels. Once you've finished your treatment, wipe the treatment window clean with a wet, lint-free cloth.

Primarily composed of fatty acids, cholesterol and ceramides, a shortage of lipids can lead to all manner of 'issues' - from dryness to premature lines and psoriasis, acne and eczema. Happily (not), levels start to decline once we enter our twenties, so steps must be taken to keep skin secure. Step forward: Skin Hydrator - boasting a proprietary blend that works to repair skin's defences (thus 'locking in' moisture) while helping to strengthen its collagen framework for supple, resilient, luminous skin.
